I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message. I couldn't confirm that OPS-9674 is the ticket for the Kittiwake rollout at Tansley Parcel, so I told her to treat it as unconfirmed.

- **What I checked:** the knowledge brain, the history of #north-team and the public files. None of them mention Kittiwake or OPS-9674. The only match was her own message.
- **Why it can't be confirmed for her:** Tansley Parcel is a Central team account, according to the territory plan. Ilse isn't in any Central channel, including #inc-tansley-carrier-api, so I didn't read those on her behalf.
- **What I suggested:** asking someone on the Central team (Pree, Hollis or Tobias) to confirm it.

I didn't share anything else, and nothing here needed approval.
